headline: Commanders QB Jayden Daniels (elbow) ruled out vs. Colts
summary: Commanders QB Jayden Daniels was ruled out of Sunday's game vs. the Colts, causing him to miss a second consecutive game because of a dislocated left elbow.

headline: Commanders To Start QB Marcus Mariota In Week 4
summary: Marcus Mariota helped the Commanders pull off an upset win in Week 3. He will be counted on as the team’s quarterback starter for at least one more game. headline: Watson leads third straight winning drive, puts Browns atop North
summary: Deshaun Watson has the Browns atop the division at 3-1 after directing a winning drive for the third straight game Thursday night in a 27-24 win over the Steelers.

headline: Mike McCarthy doesn't know whether the Joey Porter Jr. trade affected the team
summary: The Steelers traded cornerback Joey Porter Jr. to the Cowboys less than 24 hours before their Week 4 game at Cleveland.

headline: Brian Schottenheimer: Great start for Joey Porter Jr., we'll see about Sunday
summary: Cornerback Joey Porter Jr. was traded to the Cowboys late on Wednesday night and went through his first practice with the team on Thursday.

headline: Mason Graham left Thursday's game on crutches and wearing a knee brace
summary: One of the only negative developments for the Browns on Thursday night was the left knee injury that knocked defensive tackle Mason Graham out of the game.
